authorization_source: User instruction 'tiến hành tiếp' after the matched-Wayback frozen-model error analysis was reported.
hypothesis: Adding bounded within-word character 3-5 gram TF-IDF to the frozen word unigram-bigram representation may improve robustness to spelling and language variation, but must not worsen source shortcut behavior.

prior_evidence.group_split_v1_limitation: The earlier experiment used group_split_v1, which retained normalized-template leakage and the auxiliary fake_profile_post source.
prior_evidence.matched_wayback_observation: One confirmed non-English page had only 0.070981 frozen word-vocabulary coverage, while 14 of 18 nearest fit rows came from spam_email.
prior_evidence.interpretation: The prior failed ablation is adverse evidence. This protocol permits one corrected-split replication, not a new hyperparameter search.

single_challenger.combination: Sparse horizontal stack followed by row-wise L2 normalization

selection_policy.primary_metric: unweighted mean of per-source validation Macro-F1
selection_policy.if_any_gate_fails: Retain ISI_TEXT_BASELINE_V2; do not open internal test; do not create a challenger model artifact.
selection_policy.if_all_gates_pass: Freeze the validation selection only. Internal test still requires a separate owner-approved gate and external evaluation must use a new untouched benchmark.
